responsibility: This module is the core of the GNU Modula-2 mc front end: a multi-pass parser, semantic builder, and source-to-source output engine for Modula-2 compilation units. Its central declaration subsystem (decl, with nameKey and symbolKey) defines the compiler’s AST, scopes, symbols, builtins, and final emission machinery, while the staged grammars mcp1 through mcp5 progressively discover module structure, resolve types and enums, build declarations, fold constant expressions, and construct executable statement bodies. Around that core, lexer-facing components such as mcReserved, mcflex/m2flex, mcLexBuf, and mcComment provide tokenization, buffered replay across passes, source locations, include/file provenance, and preserved comments; mcError and mcMetaError provide syntax and semantic diagnostics; mcComp, mcOptions, mcSearch, mcFileName, and mcPreprocess drive compilation, option handling, file lookup, and optional preprocessing; and keyc, mcPretty, and mcStream support legal C/C++ name generation, formatted output, and fragment assembly. The remaining generic containers and utilities—Indexing, lists/alists/wlists, mcStack, varargs, mcPrintf, mcQuiet, and mcDebug—supply the reusable storage, formatting, tracing, and support logic that make this module the self-contained parser/translation subsystem of gcc/m2 rather than a target backend or GCC middle-end pass.
